dog.description_text: Meet Cloey! Cloey is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FCloey%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQoSPU7n1g4wT7eF2O%2Dn95hsEgUCYieruTJaI9e8Z04WScosMw Cloey prefers a calm environment. When there are crowds of people or many other cats she can get overwhelmed. Her foster says "She’s very cuddly and loves to be snuggled going to sleep, she eats alot and I noticed she prefers hard food over wet food. She’s so peaceful and I never have problems with her she’s a really easy baby. She tilts her head for me to pet her or randomly jumps in my bed next to me to sleep". She likes to 'talk' and is social and affectionate once she settles in. She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped, and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
